evidence.title: I was wrong about Claude. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: I was wrong about Claude
summary: Rewritten Claude Cowork setup guide: Skills and Projects instead of folders, saving money, and a plan for your first 20 minutes.
description: An instalment of the How to AI newsletter that replaces the author's earlier Cowork guides after 20 million views. Twelve sections walk through treating Cowork as many Claudes, forgetting files and folders, using only Skills + Projects, leaving settings alone, onboarding with Claude, when Cowork is the wrong tool, saving money in Cowork, and what to do in your first 20 minutes. The author notes he is not paid by Anthropic.
